Ask the explorer subagent to locate the default Chia llm_request profiler event. Then ensure a folded usage total covering more than one model is labeled mixed rather than attributed entirely to the primary model. Preserve its total counters. Keep all code changes local to this workspace.

Ask the explorer subagent to inspect OpenCode's exported assistant messages and tool states. Then make the default Chia profile emit timed assistant-turn records and internal tool spans while preserving the per-agent token totals. A model interval should end when its tool starts. Keep all code changes local to this workspace.

Ask the explorer subagent to find stable Claude Code child identifiers in the CLI event stream. Then record privacy-safe child agent_start and agent_end events in Chia's default profiler, linked to the parent call. Do not claim per-child token classes when the CLI only reports them by model. Keep all code changes local to this workspace.
